Model it with a qiskit_addon_opt_mapper OptimizationProblem: declare one binary variable per index and set a minimize objective built from the linear, quadratic, and cubic tables. Pass the cubic table to the objective through its higher_order argument, which is keyed by term degree (so the cubic coefficients live under degree 3). Because the objective contains genuine three-way interactions, the plain quadratic converter cannot represent it (it raises for higher-order terms); convert with qiskit_addon_opt_mapper.converters.OptimizationProblemToHubo (not OptimizationProblemToQubo, which can only represent linear/quadratic terms), then map the result to an Ising Hamiltonian with to_ising(). The ground-state energy plus the returned offset must equal the true minimum of the cubic objective. Name the Ising operator ``problem_hamiltonian``. Store the constant offset (the second element of the to_ising() pair) in ``energy_offset``.
